entries.title: Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt and His Likely Senate Appointee to Meet With Trump on Sunday
entries.summary: Stitt wants oil and gas executive Alan Armstrong to replace Markwayne Mullin in the Senate.
entries.content:
Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt has chosen Alan Armstrong, an oil and gas executive, to finish out the remainder of Sen. Markwayne Mullin’s term, three sources told NOTUS.

The two men are expected to meet with President Donald Trump at Mar-a-Lago on Sunday to iron out the details of the appointment and discuss it further, two of the sources said.

The sources cautioned that the pick could change following that meeting.
entries.author: Reese Gorman

entries.title: Senate Advances Markwayne Mullin’s Nomination for DHS Secretary
entries.summary: A final vote on Mullin’s nomination will likely be held this week.
entries.content:
The Senate on Sunday advanced the nomination of Sen. Markwayne Mullin as the next Homeland Security secretary, clearing a procedural hurdle while setting up a final vote as early as Monday evening.

The final tally on the motion to invoke cloture was 54-37, with nine senators not voting. Democratic Sens. John Fetterman and Martin Heinrich voted in favor of Mullin, who now only needs a simple majority in the chamber to be sworn in as outgoing Secretary Kristi Noem’s replacement.

“I have also seen first-hand that Markwayne is not someone who can simply be bullied into changing his views, and I look forward to having a Secretary who doesn’t take their orders from Stephen Miller,” Heinrich said in a statement.
entries.author: Torrie Herrington, Samuel Larreal
